title: Best Hot Tub (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were selected based on recommendations from Family Handyman, Designing Vibes, and CNET. The Coleman SaluSpa was prioritized because it is the only product recommended by more than one source.

verdict.line: It is a low-cost, portable option that avoids the need for an electrician or high upfront investment. The main catch is that it is an inflatable model, which may not suit those wanting a permanent hard-shell spa.
